name: Beehiiv social card by beehiiv.com
description: A 1200×630 social card uses a near-black indigo canvas with faint oversized geometric forms behind the content. A small centered white wordmark anchors the top, while a two-line, extremely bold uppercase headline dominates the middle with a cool lavender-to-pink gradient; a thin divider and tightly spaced uppercase feature list create a footer band.
